DEMO 2 — VOICE CLONE (4 minutes)
PRE-SETUP: The voice clip MUST be saved as an MP3 locally on your laptop BEFORE class. Don't rely on generating it live (takes time and needs good internet). Ideal: record a 20-second clip of yourself saying something funny/relatable, then clone it at elevenlabs.io the night before.
STEP 1: Play the original recording first. Tell them: "This is a real recording." STEP 2: Play the AI clone. Ask: "Is THIS real or AI? Vote — raise your hand for real." STEP 3: Reveal — "That was AI. It learned this voice from a 20-second sample." STEP 4: Deliver the line slowly and clearly: "Your voice has a fingerprint. AI just learned it in 10 seconds."
PAUSE. Let it land. Then ask: SAY: "If AI can learn your voice... what else do you think it can learn?" Take 2-3 shouted answers. Don't evaluate them — just nod and smile. They're already thinking like scientists.
PRO TIP: If you use a teacher's or principal's voice (with permission), the reaction is electric.
